stories.headline: UK launches AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.summary: The UK unveiled a national AI biosecurity lab backed by public funding and frontier-model support to speed defenses against biological threats.
stories.why_it_matters: A big government bet on AI-for-biosecurity could shape science and safety policy.

stories.headline: ARPA-H funds Alzheimer’s projects
stories.summary: ARPA-H announced up to $48.8 million for new Alzheimer’s projects, including an AI-enabled platform at Washington University in St. Louis.
stories.why_it_matters: Fresh federal funding could accelerate AI-assisted biomedical research and trials.

stories.headline: XRlabs raises $8.4M seed round
stories.summary: XRlabs announced $8.4 million in seed funding to build real-time surgical AI for operating rooms.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows investor demand for practical AI in healthcare workflows.
